video.title: Chicago Bulls Fantasy Basketball Preview [26/27 NBA Season]

summary: Josh Lloyd previews the Chicago Bulls for the 2026-27 fantasy season. He expects the Bulls to be a bad team. His projected starting five is Josh Giddey, Norman Powell, Matas Buzelis, Caleb Wilson and Nick Claxton, with Tre Jones as sixth man. Buzelis is his best target. He thinks Buzelis is a top 50 player whose Yahoo rank of about 80 is far too low. Claxton is his biggest fade at his Yahoo price of about 80. Tre Jones looks overdrafted, Jalen Smith is a late swing pick for deep leagues, and Leonard Miller is a stash. The Bulls' fantasy playoff schedule is average.

rules.text: Points, rebounds and assists count the same as other categories, but they vary less from game to game and season to season. That makes them more reliable to build a team around.

rules.text: A reliable points, rebounds and assists player is better than a player whose value comes from steals, blocks and percentages, because the production repeats more reliably.
